title: Alpine
summary: AL'PINE, adjective [Latin alpinus, from Alpes.] 1. Pertaining to the Alps, or to any lofty mountain; very high; elevated. 2. Growing on high mountains; as, alpine plants. AL'PINE, noun A kind of straw

inlines.v: AL'PINE, adjective [Latin alpinus, from Alpes.] 1. Pertaining to the Alps, or to any lofty mountain; very high; elevated. 2. Growing on high mountains; as, alpine plants. AL'PINE, noun A kind of strawberry growing on lofty hills.
